description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thumbowila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 511003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for various parcels in Thumbowila, including ownership details, property extents, encumbrances, and legal interests. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4 classification.
